info.title: Postarix API
info.description:
The API of a Postarix server: the same one the admin panel and the webmail use.

- **People** use a session cookie (sign in with `POST /api/auth/sign-in/email`); state-changing requests must send the `Origin` of the panel or webmail.
- **Scripts** use an **API key** (`Authorization: Bearer px_…`, Administration → API keys): instance-administrator access, or one organization's `/api/orgs/{orgId}/…` only.
- **Connected applications** use short **tokens** (`Authorization: Bearer pxt_…`) from `POST /api/oauth/token`, on the JMAP and `/api/mail` routes only. See the integration guide.

Errors are JSON: `{ "statusCode": 404, "message": "…" }`, with `issues` for validation errors.

post.description: Better Auth. With two-step verification on, the answer asks for the second step (`/api/auth/two-factor/verify-totp`).

get.description: With an application token: mail only; reading methods with `mail.read`, changes and uploads with `mail.write`; never another person's account. Accounts are mailbox addresses: the person's own and the shared mailboxes they belong to.

post.description: With an application token: mail only; reading methods with `mail.read`, changes and uploads with `mail.write`; never another person's account. Accounts are mailbox addresses: the person's own and the shared mailboxes they belong to. Allowed: Mailbox, Email, Thread, SearchSnippet and Blob methods (no EmailSubmission: send with POST /api/mail/send).

403.description: Method, capability or account not allowed

200.description: The blob, served with a sandboxing CSP

get.summary: Who the person may send as
get.description:
Their own address and name, the other addresses they may send as, and the shared mailboxes they may send from (with the account to save drafts in).

Connected applications may call it with a token (`Authorization: Bearer pxt_…`) with `mail.read`.

get.summary: A remote image of a rendered message
get.description: Signed links made by the message rendering; public on purpose (the signature authorizes it).

Sanitized HTML (show it in a sandboxed frame), text, attachments; remote images are replaced by links to the image proxy unless `remoteImages=1`. Reading it does not mark it read. `accountId`: a shared mailbox the person can read.

Connected applications may call it with a token (`Authorization: Bearer pxt_…`) with `mail.read` or `mail.supervise` (own mailbox only).

post.description:
Sends a draft saved in the person's mailbox, or in a shared mailbox they may send from (`accountId`). From must be an address they may send as; Bcc is removed; the copy is filed in that mailbox's Sent.

Connected applications may call it with a token (`Authorization: Bearer pxt_…`) with `mail.send`.

Inbox unread counts of up to 200 people linked to the application (by their id in it), and of the shared mailboxes they can read. Cached for 30 seconds.

Only a connected application's own token (client credentials, `mail.read`).

post.summary: Get a token for a connected application
post.description: OAuth 2.0 Token Exchange (RFC 8693) for a token acting as one person, or client credentials for the application's own token (unread counts). Client authentication: HTTP Basic with the client id and secret, `client_id` and `client_secret` in the body, or `private_key_jwt` (RFC 7523). Errors follow RFC 6749 §5.2.

subject_token.description: The person: their id in the application (an external identity of its issuer).

400.description: invalid_request, invalid_grant, invalid_scope, unsupported_grant_type or access_denied

post.summary: Convert a mailbox to shared, or back (admin panel only)
post.description:
Its mail stays where it is. To shared: its password, app passwords, sessions, external identities and application tokens go; `members` are added. To person: a new account with `password`; the members go. API keys get 403 `PANEL_ONLY`.
